title: reference/eedi_constructs.jsonl
description: One Eedi construct per line: a fine-grained learning objective, with its prerequisites. Public Eedi data, shipped unchanged. See the dataset card for its sources and licences.

construct_id.description: Eedi construct ID. Referenced by `reference/eedi_diagnostic_questions.jsonl` `construct_id` and by `prerequisite_construct_ids`.

construct_name.description: The construct's name, where the Eedi Mining Misconceptions data names it (751 of 3,277); null otherwise.

prerequisite_construct_ids.description: `construct_id`s of this construct's prerequisites, sorted. May be empty.
